about.title: ABOUT
about.intro: I am a front-end developer with a focus on building projects centered on user experience. I use the resources of the languages/libraries in which I develop to avoid overly and unnecessarily robust and illegible code, combining accessibility and usability with performance and efficiency.
about.currentRole: Currently I'm a Junior Developer at
about.intro2: , a Software House with national and international clients. I work on various projects, such as: an event organization platform; a social impact monitoring and evaluation platform for companies; a platform for commercial solutions; among others. I work daily with technologies like Typescript (using React/NextJS and NodeJS) and NoCode/Low-Code with Bubble and FlutterFlow, and I'm always under the supervision of senior developers, thus improving technical and soft skills.
about.intro3: I have certifications in Typescript and React - primary areas of focus - as well as in Node.Js, Python, Java and Cloud Computing (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner). Additionally, my previous experience as a History Teacher provided me with a solid foundation in interpersonal and collaborative skills, fostered through years of classroom experience.
about.intro4: At my free time, I like to play with my dog, take long walks on the beach, and try all kinds of RPG and Roguelike games I can find.

experience.title: EXPERIENCE
experience.description: I build and maintain the front-end of web and mobile applications for national and international clients from various sectors, from commercial solutions to corporate event organization, passing through bulk trade and sustainability metrics monitoring. I work in a multifunctional team, supervised by senior developers and in daily contact with the Design and Product Management teams.
